description: Use this when the user asks where it snowed the most or where the best powder will be (e.g. 'best powder this weekend', 'who got the most snow this week'). Rank by last 24h, past 7 days, next 7/10 days forecast, or season to date, optionally within a region. Forecast windows are modeled.

window.description: Ranking window: 24h / 7d = observed past; next7d / next10d = modeled forecast; season = season to date
